description.value: Hyatt Place Kelowna is a 161-room branded hotel located in Kelowna's Enterprise Way commercial corridor. As part of the international Hyatt Place chain, it offers the consistent service standards and facilities typical of a mid-to-upper-tier business and leisure hotel. Its location near Kelowna's main commercial strip makes it a convenient base for cyclists exploring the Okanagan.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Hyatt website returned a browser-error page (Error E6020) rather than actual hotel content, so no amenity or contact details could be verified from the website. All amenity fields are therefore null, relying only on OSM tags for identifiers. OSM confirms a 161-room Hyatt Place branded hotel at 1915 Enterprise Way, Kelowna, with internet_access=wlan tagged, but per policy OSM amenity tags are not treated as authoritative without website corroboration.
concerns: Website fetch returned a Hyatt server error page (Error E6020) with no usable content; all amenities and contact details are unverifiable from the website. A manual check of the Hyatt Place Kelowna page is recommended to populate amenity fields.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, established Hyatt Place branded hotel with 161 rooms at a verifiable Kelowna address; OSM flags it as open and it is publicly accessible to touring cyclists.
